Images.Caption: Two pirate galleons battling near an island's coastline at daytime. A shipwreck and its cargo are in the water.
A busy crew of four pirates aboard a ship, at the helm, climbing a ladder, holding food and firing a cannon.
Inside a stone fortress, pirates sat at a table by a fireplace have been surprised by two ghostly green figures.
Three creatures in a flooded cave. One is crab-like, one is wrapped by an eel, one has a head like an oyster.
A port town at sunset, with grey stone walls and red slate rooftops. A pirate ship is anchored in the distance.
Inside a dimly lit room full of candles, the pirate Captain Jack Sparrow holds up and examines a compass.
In a jungle at night, four pirates stand at the mouth of a cave shaped like a giant monkey skull.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Sea of Thieves is a smash-hit pirate adventure game, offering the quintessential pirate experience of plundering lost treasures, fighting intense battles, vanquishing sea monsters and more.

Additional digital bonuses* include access to the Sea of Thieves Original Soundtrack – 2025 Edition, the Sea of Thieves: Athena's Fortune audiobook and The Rough Guide to Sea of Thieves eBook.

* A Sea of Thieves website login is required to access the digital bonuses – visit www.seaofthieves.com/bonuses online and follow the instructions.
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Sea of Thieves is a smash-hit pirate adventure game, offering the quintessential pirate experience of plundering lost treasures, fighting intense battles, vanquishing sea monsters and more. Dive in with this revised edition of the game, which includes access to digital bonus media.

Properties.PublisherCertificateName: CN=Microsoft Corporation, O=Microsoft Corporation, L=Redmond, S=Washington, C=US

Features: Enjoy total freedom in a multiplayer world bursting with buried treasure, ancient shipwrecks and thrilling ocean battles
Immersive action and adventure from a first-person perspective
Sail solo or join a crew of up to three other players to experience true co-operative gameplay
Encounter other crews of real players in a vast, fantastical shared world filled with unspoiled islands, mythical monsters and mouth-watering loot
Supports Xbox Play Anywhere and cross-platform play (including cross-saves between Xbox One and Windows 10)
Includes Xbox Live – earn achievements, share game clips and play with friends online
